text: U.K. GDP declined 0.1% in April. Services output contracted while construction output increased modestly and production output was unchanged. Businesses reported higher energy and fuel costs during the period. Inflationary pressure from energy markets remained present while economic growth weakened.

meta.note: Growth and inflation-related pressures moved in opposite directions within the same reporting period.

text: Iranian media reported draft agreement terms while U.S. leadership publicly rejected those descriptions as inconsistent with the negotiated text. References to a possible signing remained active, and the naval blockade remained in force. Additional reported incidents in and around the Strait of Hormuz occurred alongside ongoing negotiations and conflicting public accounts of agreement status.

meta.note: Competing descriptions of the same proposed agreement prevented establishment of a unified settlement state.
